featured_reviews.name: Sunita Debnath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing service. Customers are being misled with coupons. When requesting a size exchange, I was asked to pay extra simply because I used a coupon. To make matters worse, the store manager asked, "Did you buy the coupon?" – Is this the attitude staff are trained to have?

If this is how the coupon system is managed, Reliance should seriously reconsider continuing it. I even received a call from the store inviting me to shop because my coupon was "activated" — clearly just a tactic to push sales when there's no real discount.

Very unprofessional behavior from staff. If everyday customers start recording such experiences, it could seriously damage Reliance’s reputation.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Sunita Debnath, I'm truly sorry to hear about your experience, and I appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Your feedback about our coupon system and the service at our store is invaluable, and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and misunderstanding caused. We are currently reviewing our procedures to ensure such situations are rectified, and we will work diligently to improve our staff training and customer service. Please rest assured that your experience is not reflective of our standards, and we aim to enhance your future shopping experiences significantly. If there's anything more you wish to discuss, feel free to reach out to us at customerservice@ril.com or call us at 18001027382. Thank you for your patience and understanding during this time.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a pair of jeans from trends and requested length alterations. However, I was disappointed by the response I received. Initially, I was casually told to come back the next day, despite the alteration master being present at the store. He appeared to be occupied and claimed to have a lot of work, even though a simple length alteration, which would take no more than 10 minutes, was all that was required.

After much back-and-forth discussion, the staff reluctantly agreed to proceed with the alteration. However, they made an unnecessary remark, stating that if anything went wrong, I would be held responsible. This kind of behavior and attitude is unacceptable and left me with a very poor impression of your customer service.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Jr. Reed, I'm very sorry to hear about your recent experience at our store. We strive to provide excellent service, and it seems we let you down on this occasion. Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention. Your feedback will help us improve, and we hope your next visit will be a much better experience. We'll take steps to address this behavior and enhance our customer service. Please know that your feedback is greatly valued and we're committed to making improvements. Please share your issues on customerservice@ril.com or you can call us at 18001027382.

A major issue is that shirts (especially white) have different color thread used in underarm stitching, which leaks color and stains the fabric after wash — this happened even after replacement. T-shirts also keep losing color unevenly after a few washes.
Overall, affordable but not reliable in quality.
